reveal_en: Turritopsis dohrnii, a species of jellyfish, can revert its cells back to an immature polyp stage after reaching sexual maturity, effectively restarting its life cycle. This process makes it biologically immortal.
reveal_zh: 一种名为灯塔水母的物种，在达到性成熟后能将细胞逆转回幼年水螅体阶段，从而重新开始生命周期。这使其在生物学上不朽。
meaning_en: Its unique ability challenges our fundamental understanding of aging and death in multicellular organisms.
meaning_zh: 其独特能力挑战了我们对多细胞生物衰老与死亡的根本理解。
